candidate.title: Let The LLM Write The Prompt 2025 | Design Perfect Prompts for AI Agent | Prompt Mistakes (PART 1/7)
candidate.description:
Most people type a few words and hope for answers, but effective prompting is true engineering of intelligence.

🎯 In this video:
• Why prompting is not googling—it’s architectural thinking  
• How prompt engineering is like software design  
• The power of structured prompts to unlock 1% to 100% of AI  
• A proven formula: ask the model to help you design prompts  
• Sneak peek at the 7‑part series breaking down prompt architecture

👉 If you want leverage to build advanced tools and products, start thinking in prompts.

📅 Each element of the prompt formula you’ll see here will be broken down in detail across the next 7 videos in this series.
